stage: frozen before first segment-persistence model and chronological holdout
question: Does the organizational level of payment reporting retain persistent supplier-relevant variation?
source: Actual 30 October 2026 register, unchanged original and extraction receipts retained
unit: ABN by exactly normalized published segment name by calendar half-year
primary_sample: Latest parent report per valid ABN and period from existing audit
Unredacted AASB8 report with nonblank unique segment names within report
Each three-band distribution is finite, in [0,100], and sums to 100 within 0.020001 percentage points
All-zero segment distributions are nil, excluded from performance comparisons
Group and segment mean and percentiles nonnegative, median <= P80 <= P95
At least two valid active segments in each included group-period
Stable-segment primary analysis requires identical active segment keys across all four periods and all group and active segment metrics valid
primary_outcome: Published percentage of payment transactions discharged within 30 days, not late-relative-to-contract share
descriptive_statistics: Share of groups with persistent within-group variation
primary_model: next_segment_P30 - current_group_P30 = intercept + beta_group * (current_group_P30 - 50) + beta_local * (current_segment_P30 - current_group_P30)
benchmark: Same model with beta_local omitted; both fit on the identical training rows
training: First two consecutive half-year transitions; each group gets equal total weight and its segment transitions equal weight within group
holdout: Third transition only, 2025H2 to 2026H1; no retuning based on held-out results
evaluation: Group-equal mean absolute error primary; mean squared error secondary; paired differences averaged within ABN
inference: ABN-clustered OLS sandwich for training coefficients and percentile block bootstrap of held-out group-level loss differences, fixed seed 20261101, 1999 draws
additional_predeclared_checks: Simple current group P30 and current segment P30 persistence benchmarks
Report equal segment versus equal group weighting separately
Exclude extreme P30 of 0 or 100 sensitivity
Leave one group out influence diagnostic
Contemporaneous local deviation association across adjacent periods, separately from forecasting
Check complete distributions against coordinate bounds; any unallocated share is only a conditional lower bound, not observed invoice weights
interpretation: Temporal diagnostic using a single revised snapshot; submission time is not publication time. No claimed real-time backtest, supplier behavior response, causal reform effect, or invoice-weighted population loss.
selection: This plan uses no held-out outcomes or significance to choose features, period or primary metric; prior work inspected only schema and contemporaneous ranges.
